text:
devin: Nightly eval alert: the 'doc_chain' long-context prompt set is failing 5/10 on the canary build. Instruction appears to be dropped around ~8200 tokens (looks like truncation/KV loss). Canaries: canary-v2-q8 at commit abcdef123.

maria: @devin can you paste the exact repro command + any KV/runtime logs?

devin: repro command:
```bash
run_eval --model=canary-v2-q8 --prompt=doc_chain/large_case.json --max_tokens=16384 --stream=false
```
example expectation vs actual:
```
expected tail: "Finish the summary:"
actual tail: "...continuation unrelated"  # instruction missing
```

ci-bot: Deployed canary-v2-q8 at commit abcdef123 (2026-03-18T22:10Z) :gear: CI: green

sasha: FYI we merged a quantization/eviction tweak in PR #412 that changed the default prefix-evict keep from 128->0 for 8k segment profiles. Might be related.

jon: also check for KV seqnum wrap/offset drift; we had an off-by-one in the index map earlier that could manifest at high token counts.

devin: pasted small kv dump excerpt (trimmed):
```
[KV] seq=8188 slot=0 head=8188 tail=8191 kept=0 expected_keep=128
[KV] seq=8190 slot=1 head=8190 tail=0 wrap=true
[ERR] kv_lookup failed at seq 8192 -> returning default padding
```

priya: run with RUNTIME_KV_DEBUG=1 and --force-kv-wraptest. I'll kick a repro job now with full dumps.

maria: i ran the debug job, reproduced 2/10. Logs show `evict_prefix: kept=0 expected=128` right before the missing-instruction output.

sasha: that's consistent: the new default reduces memory but if runtime config isn't synced with compiled param it'll evict too aggressively. Looks like older sessions still expect keep=128.

jon: short-term: either revert the default in the canary or add a runtime compatibility fallback: if kept==0 and model.session_start_token_count > 0 then treat as 128. Also add a unit test exercising a >8k token chain.

devin: filing INF-2041 with reproducer, dumps, and logs. assigning to @sasha for hotfix and @priya to add capture in nightly harness. Plan: hotfix -> patch canary -> rerun nightly.

priya: I'll add a KV-debug flag to nightly harness to save full dumps on any longctx failure and a small regression test that runs doc_chain at 16k tokens nightly.

maria: if we see >3/10 failures next run, initiate canary rollback. :eyes:

ci-bot: Created issue INF-2041: https://redwood.company/issue/INF-2041 and linked PRs.

sasha: taking it. I'll prepare a patch to restore default keep=128 for existing canaries and add the fallback. ETA EOD tomorrow.

devin: thanks team. keeping this thread updated with any new reproductions. :thumbsup:
